title: Reduction of the Finite Generation Problem for Leading Term Ideals under Arbitrary Rational Monomial Orders to the Lexicographic
summary: A commutative ring $R$ is called a Gröbner ring if, for every $n\geq 1$, the leading term ideal of every finitely generated ideal of $R[X_1,\ldots,X_n]$ is finitely generated with respect to the lexicographic order $X_1\succ\cdots\succ X_n$. We prove that this property is equivalent to the condition that, for every $n\geq 1$, every rational monomial order $\prec$ on $R[X_1,\ldots,X_n]$, and every finitely generated ideal $I\subseteq R[X_1,\ldots,X_n]$, the leading term ideal $\operatorname{LT}_{\prec}(I)$ is finitely generated.
